input:
The teacher's corrections in other learners' similar clauses:
- in “这个小孩子叫孟子”: 这个小孩子 → 儿子   [her note: “这个小孩子” is unclear and ambiguous]
- in “而是她望子成龙”: 她 → (deleted)   [her note: Subj.不是……而是……]
- in “他们常常搬家”: (nothing) → 所以   [her note: 无聊？add所以]
- in “孟子的妈妈一直想她的儿子在很好的地方长大”: 想她的儿子在很好的地方长大 → 想让她的儿子在很好的地方长大   [her note: 想 + V., cannot be followed by N.]
- in “古代的时候有一个男人叫孟子”: 古代的时候 → 在古代
- in “可是孟子的妈妈一直很控制他”: 可是 → (deleted)

Scene to review:
这个男孩子叫孟子，孟子是古代的人。孟子的妈妈觉得住在哪儿对童年很重要，所以他们常常搬了家。她望子成龙，所以孟子的妈妈安排他的生活。

errors.explanation: This is the first mention of the character, so use 有一个 to introduce him. 这个男孩子 suggests that the reader already knows which boy you mean.
孟子 was already named earlier in the same sentence. In the next clause of the same sentence, omit the repeated subject.
常常 describes a repeated routine, so do not use 了. Use 搬家 for something that happens regularly.

errors.original: 她望子成龙，所以孟子的妈妈安排他的生活
errors.corrected: 她望子成龙，所以安排他的生活
errors.explanation: 她 and 孟子的妈妈 refer to the same person in one sentence. After the first subject, omit the repeated subject.
